output.summary:
The pilot's core interpretation is strongly supported by the literature and is biological consensus. In a tumor region with cnLOH/LOH, the **matched normal/germline DNA remains balanced heterozygous (VAF ~0.5)** at those loci — this is the very definition that makes LOH detectable: heterozygosity is present in germline and absent in tumor. (1) cnLOH/LOH is a somatic event; the normal does not carry it, so germline het sites stay ~0.5 there (peer-reviewed consensus; KB SEQC2-CNV-LOH benchmark operationally defines LOH as "CN=2 but loss of heterozygosity"). (2) The standard tumor-normal practice is exactly to phase the **normal germline** het variants first, then use those haplotypes to haplotag tumor reads / interpret tumor allelic imbalance — this is what LongPhase-S does (KB-verified) and what WhatsHap + Battenberg-style SNP-array methods do (peer-reviewed). Because the normal stays heterozygous in LOH regions, normal-derived phasing is reliable there even though the tumor itself is allelically imbalanced. (3) cnLOH is copy-neutral (total CN stays 2) yet loses heterozygosity because mechanisms — mitotic (homologous) recombination, gene conversion, and acquired uniparental disomy (UPD), incl. break-induced replication / chromosome loss-then-reduplication — replace one parental allele segment with a duplicate of the homolog, yielding two identical copies (homozygous) of one parental haplotype without changing copy number.

Caveat for the pilot: while germline reads in the normal stay ~0.5, when you haplotag TUMOR reads in an LOH region the tumor itself shows allelic imbalance (one haplotype dominates), so any methylation/ASM read counts will be skewed by the LOH itself — the normal-balanced-het claim justifies using normal germline as the phasing scaffold, but does not imply the tumor read distribution is balanced there.

findings.claim: Normal/germline DNA remains heterozygous at a locus where the tumor shows LOH — this is the defining contrast used to detect LOH.
findings.evidence: Verbatim: 'Loss of heterozygosity can be identified in cancers by noting the presence of heterozygosity at a genetic locus in an organism's germline DNA, and the absence of heterozygosity at that locus in the cancer cells.' Detection is 'done using polymorphic markers, such as microsatellites or single-nucleotide polymorphisms, for which the two parents contributed different alleles.'
findings.source: Loss of heterozygosity — Wikipedia (well-sourced encyclopedic synthesis of primary literature), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loss_of_heterozygosity
findings.relevance: Directly answers sub-question (1): germline het is retained in normal at tumor-LOH loci. This is the core justification for the pilot's interpretation.

findings.claim: A germline heterozygous variant has VAF = 0.5 in the normal sample; in tumor SCNA/LOH regions that VAF deviates from 0.5 due to allelic imbalance, and this normal-vs-tumor contrast is used to phase germline variants.
findings.evidence: Figure 1 caption: 'In the normal sample, both SNVs have a VAF of 0.5' and 'In the tumor sample, SNV1 is overrepresented (VAF = 0.75) and SNV2 is underrepresented (VAF = 0.25).' Results: 'Germline variants on the chromosome that is more abundant will appear to increase in VAF in the tumor, whereas variants on less abundant chromosomes will appear to decrease in VAF... Changes in VAF between tumor and normal samples can be used to infer chromosome of origin, or phase, of germline variants.'
findings.source: Skidmore ZL et al., 'Rare variant phasing using paired tumor:normal sequence data' (BMC Bioinformatics), PMC6537421, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6537421/
findings.relevance: Peer-reviewed quantitative confirmation that germline het = VAF 0.5 in normal and is balanced even where the tumor is imbalanced (LOH/SCNA). Directly supports sub-questions (1) and (2).

findings.claim: cnLOH is copy-neutral (no net change in copy number) but loses heterozygosity via mitotic recombination, gene conversion, or acquired uniparental disomy (UPD).
findings.evidence: Verbatim: 'Copy-neutral LOH is thus called because no net change in the copy number occurs in the affected individual.' 'Possible causes for copy-neutral LOH include acquired uniparental disomy (UPD) and gene conversion.' 'In UPD, a person receives two copies of a chromosome, or part of a chromosome, from one parent and no copies from the other parent.' Acquired UPD arises 'when a somatic cell undergoes mitotic recombination or repairs a broken chromosome using its homolog as a template (break-induced replication)... the cell replaces the chromosome segment carrying the wild-type allele with a copy of the segment carrying the mutated allele.'
findings.source: Loss of heterozygosity — Wikipedia (synthesizing primary literature), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loss_of_heterozygosity
findings.relevance: Answers sub-question (3): the mechanism explanation for copy-neutral-but-loses-heterozygosity.

findings.claim: cnLOH / acquired UPD duplicates one parental allele and concurrently loses the other (homozygous outcome) while total copy number stays diploid; mitotic recombination is a major contributor.
findings.evidence: Verbatim: 'CN-LOH, also often referred to as uniparental disomy (UPD), leads to LOH by duplication of a maternal (unimaternal) or paternal (unipaternal) chromosome or chromosomal region and concurrent loss of the other allele.' 'When a homozygous constellation of genotyping calls is combined with diploid copy number, the diagnosis of CN-LOH can be established.' 'Mitotic recombination is considered a major contributor to acquired CN-LOH... CN-LOH can occur as the result of mitotic recombination between homologous chromosomes.'
findings.source: O'Keefe C, McDevitt MA, Maciejewski JP. 'Copy neutral loss of heterozygosity: a novel chromosomal lesion in myeloid malignancies.' Blood. 2010;115(14):2731-2739, PMC2854422, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2854422/
findings.relevance: Peer-reviewed primary review (Blood/ASH) giving the mechanistic and diagnostic definition for sub-question (3); links diploid copy number + homozygous genotype = cnLOH.

findings.claim: cnLOH/acquired UPD is a somatic, non-random event in cancer that acts as Knudson's 'second hit', revealing a homozygous mutation while germline carriers are heterozygous.
findings.evidence: Search synthesis: 'Potential mechanisms of copy neutral loss of heterozygosity include mitotic recombination, gene conversion, or trisomy rescue in somatic cells, serving as the second hit in the Knudson two-hit tumorigenesis hypothesis.' Companion primary source: 'The non-random landscape of somatically-acquired uniparental disomy in cancer.'
findings.source: Web synthesis + Lozano R et al. (companion) 'The non-random landscape of somatically-acquired uniparental disomy in cancer', PMC6592296, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6592296/
findings.relevance: Reinforces that cnLOH is somatic (not germline), so the matched normal does not carry it — the basis of the pilot interpretation (sub-question 1).

findings.claim: Standard tumor-normal somatic phasing first phases NORMAL germline variants, then haplotags tumor reads against that germline haplotype scaffold.
findings.evidence: KB workflow (verbatim steps): 'Step 1: Phase Normal Germline Variants — longphase-s phase -s normal_snp.vcf -b normal.bam ...; Step 2: Somatic Haplotagging — longphase-s somatic_haplotag -s phased_normal.vcf ... --tumor-bam-file tumor.bam'. KB best practice: '優先使用 tumor-normal 模式：當有配對 normal 樣本時，tumor-normal phasing 提供更準確的 haplotype 資訊.' LongPhase-S GHIR feature = 'phased germline het 位點在 tumor 的 haplotype imbalance'.
findings.source: KB kb-06-workflows-phasing-workflow (06_workflows/phasing-workflow.md, last_verified 2026-04-01, source_type runtime-fact) + kb-05-tools-longphase-s
findings.relevance: Answers sub-question (2): the project's own tool (LongPhase-S) implements exactly the normal-germline-then-tumor-haplotag pattern; GHIR explicitly measures germline-het imbalance in tumor, presupposing normal het balance.

findings.claim: The community-standard way to interpret tumor allelic imbalance is to statistically phase heterozygous SNPs from the matched NORMAL, then color tumor BAF by the inferred germline haplotypes (Battenberg-style); WhatsHap haplotags reads from phased het SNPs.
findings.evidence: Search synthesis: 'Studies have statistically phased heterozygous SNP genotypes from matched normal samples and plotted tumor BAFs by color according to alignment with inferred haplotypes, forming so-called Battenberg plots.' 'WhatsHap... arrange reads into two haplotypes' and haplotag outputs 'read name, haplotype (H1/H2/none), phase set, contig.'
findings.source: Web synthesis of San Lucas et al., Genome Research 2013 'Haplotype-based profiling of subtle allelic imbalance with SNP arrays' (https://genome.cshlp.org/content/23/1/152, PMID 23028187) + WhatsHap protocol (Springer, https://link.springer.com/protocol/10.1007/978-1-0716-2819-5_8)
findings.relevance: Confirms sub-question (2) is field-wide consensus practice (not just LongPhase): matched-normal germline het is the phasing reference; LOH/imbalance is read off the tumor against it.

findings.claim: In HCC1395 (the project's main sample), cnLOH is extensive: SEQC2 benchmark labels ~1490.4 Mb as 'CN=2 but loss of heterozygosity', distinct from copy-number loss segments.
findings.evidence: KB table (verbatim): '| LOH（CN = 2 但失去 heterozygosity） | 1490.4 Mb | 包含在合併 BED 中 |'. Context: HCC1395 ploidy 2.85 (hyper-diploid); benchmark by Masood et al., Genome Biology 2024, validated with 3 orthogonal technologies (Affymetrix CytoScan, Illumina BeadChip, Bionano).
findings.source: KB kb-02-samples-hcc1395 (02_samples/hcc1395.md, last_verified 2026-04-03) citing Masood et al., Genome Biology 2024, DOI 10.1186/s13059-024-03294-8
findings.relevance: Quantifies how much of the project's main sample is copy-neutral LOH (operational confirmation that cnLOH = CN2 + lost het), grounding the pilot in real benchmark numbers.

key_takeaways: YES, it is literature consensus: in a tumor cnLOH/LOH region the matched germline/normal remains balanced heterozygous (VAF ~0.5). LOH is defined precisely as 'heterozygous in germline, homozygous/imbalanced in tumor' — that contrast is what makes LOH detectable (Wikipedia LOH; Skidmore et al. PMC6537421 Fig 1: normal VAF = 0.5).

Sub-question (1) confirmed — peer-reviewed: cnLOH/UPD is a SOMATIC second-hit event (Knudson); the normal does not carry it, so germline het sites stay ~0.5 there. (O'Keefe/Maciejewski Blood 2010; Lozano PMC6592296.)

Sub-question (2) confirmed — KB + peer-reviewed: the STANDARD tumor-normal practice is to phase normal germline het variants first, then haplotag tumor reads / interpret tumor allelic imbalance against that scaffold. LongPhase-S does exactly this (KB-verified, 2-step workflow; GHIR = germline-het imbalance in tumor). Same pattern in WhatsHap + Battenberg/SNP-array haplotype methods (San Lucas Genome Research 2013).

Sub-question (3) confirmed — peer-reviewed: cnLOH is copy-neutral (total CN stays 2) yet loses heterozygosity because mitotic (homologous) recombination, gene conversion, or acquired UPD (incl. break-induced replication or chromosome-loss-then-reduplication) replace one parental allele segment with a duplicate of the homolog -> two identical copies of one haplotype, no copy-number change. (Wikipedia LOH; O'Keefe Blood 2010.)

Project grounding: HCC1395 has ~1490.4 Mb labelled 'CN=2 but loss of heterozygosity' in the SEQC2 benchmark (Masood et al. Genome Biology 2024) — cnLOH is operationally defined there as diploid-CN + lost-het, exactly matching the textbook mechanism.

IMPORTANT caveat for the pilot: 'normal is balanced het at ~0.5' justifies using normal germline as the phasing reference, but it does NOT mean the TUMOR read distribution is balanced in that region — by definition the tumor is allelically imbalanced there, so haplotag-derived per-haplotype read/methylation counts in LOH regions will be skewed by the LOH itself and must be normalized/controlled (cf. KB ASM ALLELE-axis confound memory).
open_questions: Quantitative reliability of normal-germline phasing specifically within long cnLOH segments (e.g., switch-error / haplotag dropout when the normal is genuinely heterozygous but coverage/het density varies) — KB cites LongPhase v2.0 switch error ~0.055% genome-wide but no LOH-region-stratified number was found. Worth verifying empirically on HCC1395BL normal in the 1490.4 Mb LOH BED.

How much of HCC1395's cnLOH is segmental mitotic-recombination vs whole-chromosome UPD vs gene conversion was not resolved from these sources — would need the Masood Genome Biology 2024 supplement or the UPD-landscape paper (PMC6592296) for HCC1395-specific mechanism breakdown.

Whether residual normal-cell contamination in the tumor BAM (impurity) restores partial heterozygosity at tumor-cnLOH loci enough to bias VAF/phasing — the tumor-purity literature is relevant but no LOH-specific impurity correction source was retrieved here.

No source was found that directly benchmarks methylation/ASM read-count skew specifically attributable to cnLOH (as opposed to copy-number LOH); the pilot may need its own analysis since the project's prior ASM memory already flags ALLELE-axis confounding by baseline allelic methylation.

output.summary:
調查確認用戶的核心觀察解釋成立：HCC1395 雖是近乎 100% 純度的腫瘤 cell line，但因 (a) subclonal（次克隆）CNV/LOH 只存在於部分細胞、(b) SEQC2 LOH benchmark 是用 bulk WGS 跨 378 個資料集的 consensus 建立、(c) bulk read 是所有 subclone 的混合，故 SEQC2 標為 LOH 的區段在 tumor read 層仍可能保有 ~0.5 的 het VAF（部分細胞未發生該 LOH，或 LOH 本身就只在一個 subclone 中）。三個子問題逐一回答如下。

(1) 純度：HCC1395 是已建立的乳腺 ductal carcinoma（TNBC）cell line，配對 normal 為同病人 B-lymphoblast HCC1395BL。作為 in vitro cell line，它沒有真實活檢的間質/免疫細胞污染 — SEQC2 論文以 CNA 估計 purity = 99%（KB 與 PMC8532138 一致），LongPhase-S subsample 設計也把純 tumor BAM t50_n00 直接記為 100% purity。但「純度 ≈100%」不等於「同質」：cell line 內部仍是多個 subclone 的混合群體。用戶實際在用的 ONT BAM（/big8_disk/data/HCC1395/）即是此 cell line 的 bulk pool。

(2) Subclonal CNV/LOH → bulk VAF 介於 0.5 與 0/1：HCC1395 經 bulk 與 single-cell DNA-seq 確認具分支演化（branching evolution）的多個 subclone。SEQC2 SV 論文觀察到 somatic SNV 的 VAF 次峰落在 0.15 與 0.08，明確歸因於 subclone。當一個 CNV/LOH 事件只發生在部分細胞（subclonal）時，bulk read 是「已發生 LOH 的細胞」與「仍雜合的細胞」的線性混合，故位點的等位基因平衡會介於完全雜合（~0.5）與完全 LOH（→0/1）之間，這正是用戶看到的現象。

(3) SEQC2 LOH 是 bulk consensus：SEQC2 CNV/LOH benchmark（Masood et al., Genome Biology 2024）以 6 種 CNV caller × 21 WGS replicates（126 call sets）做 consensus scoring，再用 3 種正交技術驗證；其 LOH 定義是「CN=2 但失去 heterozygosity」的 segment-level 標註，是對整個 bulk 群體的多數決，會把 subclonal/部分細胞的 LOH 一併標為 LOH segment。因此「SEQC2 標 LOH 但 tumor read VAF~0.5」並不矛盾：segment-level bulk-consensus LOH 標註與 read-level allele balance 是不同尺度，subclonal LOH 在 read 層必然殘留部分雜合。

findings.claim: HCC1395 是已建立的乳腺 ductal carcinoma cell line，配對 normal 為同病人 B-lymphoblast HCC1395BL；作為 in vitro cell line 無真實活檢的間質/免疫污染。
findings.evidence: KB hcc1395.md：『HCC1395 是一個乳腺導管癌 (ductal carcinoma) cell line，配對的 normal 為 HCC1395BL（來自同一患者的 B-lymphoblast cell line）』。ATCC CRL-2324 / CRL-2325 列為兩株獨立 established cell line（病人 43 歲女性 TNM Stage I grade 3 ductal carcinoma）。
findings.relevance: 回答子問題(1)：確認它是 cell line 而非 bulk 活檢，沒有真實腫瘤微環境的 stromal/normal 細胞混入。

findings.claim: SEQC2 以 copy number alteration 估計 HCC1395 tumor purity ≈ 99%（典型乳癌 cell line 應有的高純度）。
findings.evidence: PMC8532138 (SEQC2 SV paper) 取得內容：『The estimated purity based on CNAs was 99%, as expected for a typical breast cancer cell line.』KB subsample-purity.md 亦把純 tumor BAM t50_n00 列為 100% purity。
findings.relevance: 回答子問題(1)：ONT BAM 對應的 cell line 純度極高(~99-100%)，所以 VAF~0.5 不是 normal 污染稀釋造成，必須由 subclonal/copy-number 結構解釋。

findings.claim: HCC1395 內部具分支演化的多個 subclone（bulk DNA-seq 推斷並經 single-cell DNA-seq 確認），somatic SNV 的 VAF 次峰落在 0.15 與 0.08，歸因於 subclone。
findings.evidence: SEQC2 SV 論文：『peaks of VAF at 0.15 and 0.08, suggesting that these SNVs were from subclones』，並描述 branching evolution / 兩大分支 / 多 subclone (S1-S10)。WebSearch 摘要：『subclones and heterogeneity of the HCC1395 cell line were inferred with bulk DNA sequencing, and the results were confirmed by single-cell DNA sequencing analysis』。
findings.source: Talsania et al. Genome Biology 2022, 10.1186/s13059-022-02816-6 (via PMC8532138 SEQC2 fetch + WebSearch)
findings.relevance: 回答子問題(2)：直接證明 cell line 即使純度~99% 仍是多 subclone 混合，部分變異/CNV/LOH 只存在於部分細胞，必然產生介於 0.5 與 0/1 的 bulk VAF。

findings.claim: HCC1395 為 hyper-diploid（ploidy 2.85），CNA 覆蓋 ~56% 基因組、>256 複雜重排，並有 clonal copy-neutral LOH (NLOH) 於 chr17q、TP53 driver、PIK3CA early driver。
findings.evidence: KB hcc1395.md：『Genome Ploidy 2.85 (hyper-diploid)』『CNV/LOH benchmark... LOH 1490.4 Mb』。SEQC2 paper：『CNAs in ~56% of the genome and >256 complex genomic rearrangements... aneuploid genome』。WebSearch：『clonal driver mutation in TP53, clonal copy neutral loss of heterozygosity (NLOH) at chromosome 17q and an early driver mutation in PIK3CA』。
findings.relevance: 回答子問題(2)(3)：local copy number≠2 與 CNLOH 會直接改變每位點預期 VAF；subsample-purity.md 也載明 het somatic VAF=P/2 之公式『假設 diploid het；在 CNV/LOH/WGD 區域 local CN 改變 VAF 需另計』。

findings.claim: SEQC2 LOH/CNV benchmark 是 bulk WGS 的多數決 consensus：6 種 CNV caller × 21 WGS replicates(6 中心)=126 call sets 做 group-score consensus，再用 3 種正交技術驗證；LOH 定義為 segment-level『CN=2 但失去 heterozygosity』。
findings.evidence: KB seqc2-truth-set.md：『6 種 CNV callers 應用於 21 WGS replicates，產出 126 call sets... 分為 Strong/Medium/Weak/Neutral... 用 Affymetrix CytoScan、Illumina BeadChip、Bionano 驗證』『LOH：CN=2（失去 heterozygosity）1490.4 Mb』『LOH 定義: 此處 LOH 指 CN=2 但一條 haplotype 完全缺失，不同於 LongPhase-TO 基於 phased genotype ratio 的 LOH detection』。
findings.relevance: 回答子問題(3)：證明 SEQC2 LOH 是 bulk 群體的 segment-level consensus 標註，會把只在部分細胞發生的 subclonal LOH 一併標為 LOH region，與 read-level allele balance 是不同尺度。

findings.claim: SEQC2 SNV/INDEL truth set 同樣是 bulk consensus（1500x WGS、7 中心、378 call sets），且低 VAF(<5%) subclonal 變異需特殊處理才能升級信心度。
findings.evidence: KB paper-index.md + seqc2-truth-set.md：『21 replicates × 3 aligners × 6 callers = 378 call sets』『WGS at 1500x coverage across 7 sequencing centers』。SEQC2 PMC8532138：『low-VAF (<5%) variants 需用 pooled 1500x 來 rescue LowConf』『somatic mutations called from 378 datasets... consolidated by two ML-based classifiers』。
findings.source: /big8_disk/.../04_databases/seqc2-truth-set.md + 08_references/paper-index.md (KB); Fang et al. Nat Biotechnol 2021 PMC8532138
findings.relevance: 回答子問題(3)：整個 SEQC2 truth set（含 LOH）都是 bulk 群體層級的 consensus，本質上會把 subclonal 事件平均化／標準化為 segment 標註，read 層仍保留 subclonal mosaic。

findings.claim: Subclonal LOH 在 bulk read 層必然殘留部分雜合：bulk read 是『已 LOH 細胞』與『仍 het 細胞』的線性混合，allele balance 介於 ~0.5(完全 het) 與 0/1(完全 LOH) 之間，是公認的 bulk 推斷限制。
findings.evidence: CNAqc (Genome Biology 2024, 10.1186/s13059-024-03170-5) 與 tumour-only LOH 推斷文獻(PMC6148761)指出：clonality 由 VAF + local copy number 推斷，CNLOH(2:0) 等基因型需從 wildtype diploid het 參考的等位修改數計算；subclonal CNA/LOH 只影響部分細胞群。Glioma 空間異質性研究(PMC12166086)直接以『spatial subclonal genomic heterogeneity of loss of heterozygosity』為題證實 LOH 可只在部分區域/細胞。
findings.source: CNAqc https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s13059-024-03170-5 ; tumor-only LOH inference https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6148761/ ; glioma spatial subclonal LOH https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC40514380 (PMID 40514380)
findings.relevance: 回答子問題(2)(3)：提供 cell-line 之外的通用機制證據 — bulk consensus LOH 標註與 read-level allele balance 不矛盾，subclonal LOH 是 read 層殘留雜合的標準解釋。

findings.claim: 本專案 ONT HCC1395 資料集純度與口徑：t50_n00=100% 純 tumor；het somatic VAF≈purity/2 僅在 diploid-het 假設成立，CNV/LOH/WGD 區域需用 local copy number 另計。
findings.evidence: KB subsample-purity.md：『Heterozygous Somatic Variant... 預期 VAF = P/2（此式假設該位點為 diploid heterozygous；在 CNV/LOH/WGD 區域，local copy number 會改變 VAF，需另計）』；purity 口徑已正名為 tumor DNA fraction，WGD/aneuploidy 時 DNA fraction > cellular purity。
findings.relevance: 把通用機制接回用戶實際數據：在 HCC1395 hyper-diploid + CNLOH 17q 區段，純 diploid-het 的 VAF 預期不適用，read 層 VAF~0.5 既可能來自 subclonal LOH 也可能來自 local CN 結構，兩者皆與 SEQC2 segment LOH 標註相容。

key_takeaways: HCC1395 純度極高(~99-100%，established cell line 無真實間質/normal 污染)，所以 tumor read VAF~0.5 不是 normal 細胞稀釋造成，必須由 subclonal 結構與 local copy number 解釋。
Cell line ≠ 同質：HCC1395 經 bulk 與 single-cell DNA-seq 確認有分支演化的多個 subclone(SNV VAF 次峰 0.15/0.08)；subclonal CNV/LOH 只存在於部分細胞。
Subclonal LOH 在 bulk read 層必然殘留部分雜合 — bulk 是『已 LOH 細胞』與『仍 het 細胞』的線性混合，allele balance 落在 ~0.5 與 0/1 之間，這正是用戶看到的現象。
SEQC2 LOH 是 bulk WGS 跨 378 dataset(SNV)/126 call set(CNV) 的 segment-level consensus 多數決，會把 subclonal/部分細胞 LOH 一併標為 LOH region；segment-level bulk 標註與 read-level allele balance 是不同尺度，兩者不矛盾。
HCC1395 是 hyper-diploid(ploidy 2.85)且有 chr17q copy-neutral LOH(CNLOH 2:0) — CNLOH 區段 CN=2 但只剩一條 haplotype，clonal CNLOH 在 read 層應趨近 LOH，若 read 仍 ~0.5 則更指向該 LOH segment 中混有 subclonal 或 local-CN 異質性。
本專案的 het somatic VAF≈purity/2 公式僅在 diploid-het 假設成立；在 HCC1395 的 CNV/LOH/WGD 區段需以 local copy number 另計(KB subsample-purity.md 已明載)。
open_questions: 用戶觀察到 VAF~0.5 的具體位點落在哪一類 SEQC2 segment？需區分：(a) clonal CNLOH 17q(read 應趨近 LOH，若仍 0.5 則異常需查 phasing/germline 污染)、(b) subclonal LOH(部分細胞，read 0.5↔0/1 之間合理)、(c) gain 區的 het(CN>2 het 本就非 0.5)。逐位點交叉 SEQC2 ngs_benchmark_cnvs_gain_loss_loh.bed 的 type 欄與 median CN 可定性。
SEQC2 CNV/LOH benchmark 的 LOH 是 WGS short-read 建立；用戶用 ONT long-read，技術差異(mapping/het 位點密度)是否額外貢獻 read-level het 殘留，KB 標註『比較時需考慮技術差異』但未量化。
LongPhase-S 對用戶實際 ONT HCC1395(HKU 版)估計的 tumor DNA fraction 具體數值未能直接取得(biorxiv 403)；若需精確 ONT BAM purity，建議直接讀 LongPhase-S 輸出 ##tumor_purity= 或 KB 05_tools/longphase-s.md。
HCC1395 各 subclone 的 cancer cell fraction(CCF)分佈與其攜帶的 LOH segment 對應表，現有 KB/已取得文獻僅給 SNV VAF 次峰(0.15/0.08)未給 LOH-specific CCF；要完整解釋特定 LOH 位點的 0.5 需 single-cell 或 CCF 反推。

<tier>peer-reviewed</tier>

<evidence>「the majority (79%) of the aDMRs mapped to heterozygous copy number variant (CNV) and LOH regions」；「the number of aDMRs ... positively correlated with the fraction of the genome in LOH regions (Pearson r = 0.469, p = 2.6 × 10−11)」。Cohort 偵測 ~4.46M aDMRs（tumor mean 23.61K vs normal mean 4.7K，約 5×），tumor-specific ~462K（濾除 imprinted 後）；recurrent promoter aDMR 涉 2,854 基因含 RET、CDKN2A。</evidence>

<takeaway>cnLOH 的核心效應是「把區域塌縮成單一親代 haplotype 的兩個拷貝」：因此依賴兩條序列不同 germline 等位的 ASM（imprinting 為典型）會同質化為存活等位的值（近 0% 或 100%，與拷貝數無關）。甲基「訊號量」被保留在存活等位上、但失去 allele 間對比 — 這是「同質化 germline ASM」與「retained 單等位甲基」兩種說法可以並存的關鍵區辨（peer-reviewed: Nat Commun 2017 PMC5589900）。</takeaway>
<takeaway>「LOH/cnLOH 區仍觀察到 haplotype 間甲基差異」是文獻明確報告且富集的現象（79% aDMR 落在 CNV/LOH 區、與 LOH fraction r=0.469 正相關；Cell Genomics 2024 PMC11605692）。但機制多為 tumor-acquired（de novo）allele-specific 甲基化、亞克隆/不完全 isodisomy 殘留等位，或單等位高甲基 + 另一等位 LOH 的 biallelic inactivation（BRCA1 canonical 例）— 不是保留的 germline 雙親 ASM。</takeaway>
<takeaway>對 InterSubMod 的直接啟示：在 LOH 區比較 HP1 vs HP2 甲基差異時，必須 (a) 以拷貝數校正避免把 copy-number artifact 誤判為 epigenetic 訊號；(b) 先濾除 imprinted DMR；(c) X 染色體與 autosome 分開處理（XCI 基線 confound）；(d) 用「allelic loss of gene-body methylation = tumor-specific」之類 discriminator 區分 germline-ASM 與 tumor-acquired ASM。此與既有 memory「ASM ALLELE-axis 被 baseline allelic 甲基化 confound — 必跑 germline-het null」一致並補強了文獻機制依據。</takeaway>
<takeaway>imprinting × cnLOH：依複製甲基化/未甲基化親代等位 → gain/loss of imprinting；XCI × cnLOH：X 的 cnLOH 功能等同 two-hit/LOH，癌症中 XCI skewing 增加（peer-reviewed: Frontiers Genet 2026, PLOS One 2015）。</takeaway>
<takeaway>本地 KB 不涵蓋本主題生物學機制（僅工具/方法論），所有機制結論均來自外部 PubMed/期刊；已標 tier。BMC review 全文遭 auth wall 未取得（標 blog-weak）；其餘核心 claim 皆有 PMC 開放全文一手核對（peer-reviewed）。</takeaway>
